_comment: Collector behaviour. Thresholds and budgets are deliberately conservative until free-tier limits are confirmed in Google AI Studio. Providers run in order; to add any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, Cloudflare Workers AI, Ollama, vLLM) append { "id": "openrouter", "kind": "openai_compatible", "base_url": "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "model": "<model>:free", "env": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", "json_mode": "json_object", "rpm": 10, "daily_calls": 40, "batch_size": 3 } and set that env var as a repo secret (also add it to collect.yml).
_review_not_ai_comment: When true, severity-4 claims with no AI role (confirmed real-world loss: HIBP breaches, say) wait in the review queue. Off since 2026-10-30: nobody tended the queue, so the largest breaches of the week (Polymarket, iRhythm, Sony So-net) never reached the site. Low-confidence items still go to review.

dedupe._comment: Headlines about one event from different outlets score 0.16-0.52 on title similarity, so llm_check_similarity sits at 0.40 and two more triggers ask the model: a shared rare title token (entity_max_df, entity_window_days) and, after classification, a shared product with incident dates within product_window_days. A false trigger costs one LLM call, never a merge: merges need the model's answer at confidence 0.6 or more.

classify._comment: The fuse: at most this many clusters are classified per run; the rest wait for the next hourly run.

update._comment: Timeline updates (a known record gets a new report) asked of the model per call.

ghsa_lookup._comment: GitHub Advisory Database lookups by CVE id for live patch and supply-chain records that lack version data; negatives are asked again after recheck_days.

fetch.user_agent: gcd-ai-radar/0.1 (+https://github.com/eshin087/gcd-ai-radar; incident observatory, feeds and official APIs only)

hibp._comment: Have I Been Pwned breach API: only verified breaches of at least this many accounts become candidates; smaller ones reach us through the press feeds if at all.

_providers_comment: Free-tier limits read from Google AI Studio on 2026-10-18: gemini-3.5-flash-lite 15 RPM / 250K TPM / 500 RPD; gemini-3.8-flash 5 RPM / 250K TPM / 20 RPD. Budgets stay just under those; daily quotas reset at midnight Pacific.

alerts._comment: The job fails (so GitHub emails the owner) after stalled_runs consecutive scheduled runs that classified nothing while candidates waited, e.g. every LLM provider down or out of quota. With the Worker's half-hourly dispatch 24 is half a day. pending_warn only warns in the job summary.

retention._comment: runs_keep is the quota ledger: 240 half-hourly runs is five days, well over the one day a quota covers. Source schedules live in collector-state.json, not here.
